messages:
morgan: Heads-up — planning to cut over SDK v3.4 next Tue 22:00 UTC. This is a non-incident rollout for the client-facing HTTP bindings. Posting checklist & owners here for async coordination.
elaine: Thanks — can you confirm which clients we need to notify? external partners + NPM package users?
samir: +1 on partners. Also add mobile SDK teams (ios/android) and integrations team. We should gate warnings for semver-major changes.
dave: Quick compatibility note: v3.4 changes error payload shape for rate_limit. It’s backwards compatible except for clients that parse fields strictly. We added a feature-flagged fallback for old shape.
morgan: Right — fallback will be on by default for the first 48hrs, then flip off if no regressions. Owner for the fallback flip: @dave.
lucy: Who's owning the smoke checklist and where do we run it? I can own smoke runs for hosted endpoints if someone shares the route list.
elain: (typo) — elaine: I can do SDK smoke runs for node + python bindings. I'll run the tests against staging after canary.
dave: I’ll do the feature-flag flip and be on-call for rollback. If we need to rollback I have the rollback playbook here: https://internal.redwood/rollbacks/sdk-v3.4 (contains steps + scripts).
morgan: Great. Canaries: schedule two canary waves at 18:00 and 20:30 UTC same day. Canary size 1% then 5%. If both green then proceed to global at 22:00.
samir: What constitutes green? latency < 200ms p50, error rate < 0.2% and no parsing errors in partner tests.
lucy: I'll add partner integration smoke tests to the canary job. Need API routes list from @morgan.
morgan: Pushed list to the deployment doc: https://internal.redwood/deploys/sdk-v3.4/routes.md — includes example requests and partner tokens.
api-docs-bot: api-docs-bot: Note: CHANGELOG and migration guide draft created at https://internal.redwood/docs/sdk-v3.4-migration.md
elaine: For client comms — recommend two messages: (1) an announcement email to partners 48hrs prior + RFC in #partners with migration highlights; (2) a deprecation warning in the SDK console for 7 days before flipping fallback. @samir can you draft partner email?
samir: I can draft. Will post to this thread for review by EOD.
dave: Rollback readiness: rollback script tested yesterday on staging. I will be available 21:30–23:30 UTC during the cutover. If rollback happens, expected downtime < 3 minutes for SDK publish revert and 1–2 mins for routing rollbacks.
lucy: Who publishes the npm/pypi packages? We should avoid publishing during the canary window.
morgan: @lucy please coordinate with release-engineering. Release-eng will publish at 22:05 UTC after a green signal. If rollback, do not publish and run the revert script instead.
elain: (again typo) — elaine: Doc updates — I'll add migration examples and a small code snippet showing error parsing fallback.
elaine: Also add a snippet for the new optional field: `rate_limit.reason_code` and how to safely access it.
dave: Example snippet for node: ```js const r = resp.rate_limit?.reason_code ?? 'unknown'; ```
samir: Partner communication draft (first pass) — "We will roll SDK v3.4 on Tue 22:00 UTC. v3.4 changes rate_limit payload. We provide a 48-hour fallback by default. Please run integration tests against staging and report issues." Posting in thread now: https://internal.redwood/msgs/partner-draft-3.
elaine: LGTM, minor wording: mention timeline for fallback flip and how to request extended fallback for specific customers.
morgan: Who's monitoring party during rollout? Ops dashboard owner?
lucy: I'll set up a dashboard with the three checks: latency, 5xx, parsing errors. Sharing alert links now.
dave: I'll watch logs and be ready to trigger rollback. I also added a smoke alert to the runbook: if parsing_errors > 5 in 15m, we pause and rollback.
morgan: Final ask: everyone who owns a task, add a short line to the deploy doc with your name + task and expected done-by timestamp. I'll compile and ping on slack 1hr before.
samir: Added my draft email and test plan.
elain: elaine: SDK smoke test matrix updated.
lucy: Dashboard created and alert subscriptions set to mobile-eng, integrations, eng-oncall.
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Scheduled: SDK v3.4 global roll at 1958765632 (Tue 22:00 UTC). Canary 1 at 1958764800 (18:00 UTC), Canary 2 at 1958766200 (20:30 UTC).
morgan: Thanks all. If anyone can't make their window, call it out now. Otherwise I'll post the final coordinator message 24hrs before cutover. :thumbsup:
